observations: Photo 0: a single light-colored, clean, new-looking wooden pallet on a bare concrete floor, watermarked 'DANTILA RESOURCES / POSTED ON JIJI'.
Photo 1: the same single pallet from a slightly different angle, same clean condition, same watermark.

Photo 2: a large stack of multiple wooden pallets that are dark, weathered, worn, with visible dirt, staining and rough edges, under open sky — visually inconsistent with the clean pallet in photos 0-1.
No scale, weighbridge, or weight readout is shown in any photo.
No count or tally of pallets is visible; it is unclear if the sale is for one pallet or a bulk lot.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing
claims.evidence: Generic marketing statement, not a checkable fact about this specific item.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows a stack of visibly dirty, weathered, water-stained pallets, inconsistent with the clean condition shown in photos 0-1.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale, readout, or weighing photo/video is shown in any of the 3 photos.

risks.risk: Unclear quantity: photos show one clean pallet and a separate stack of worn pallets, but no count of how many units are actually included in the sale.
risks.proof: A single photo showing the full lot laid out with a visible count, or a tally/number stated against a clear shot of the stack.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the single unit shown, not as a 500kg bulk lot

risks.risk: Condition mismatch: the item actually delivered could be the worn, weathered pallets from photo 2 rather than the clean one in photos 0-1.
risks.proof: A close-up of the exact pallets to be delivered, timestamped, matching the clean examples.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the worn/weathered condition seen in photo 2 (worst case)

risks.risk: No proof of dryness or absence of water/mold damage inside the wood (claim of 'no water added').
risks.proof: A moisture-meter reading photo or a cut cross-section of the wood.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified dry, i.e. standard/used-grade condition

risks.risk: No proof of the 500kg weighing claim or what that weight corresponds to (one pallet vs a full stack).
risks.proof: A photo/video of the pallets on a scale with the readout visible and pallets identifiable.
risks.if_unproven: ignored for pricing; price based on visible unit count only

proof_requests: A clear photo showing the exact pallets being sold, with a visible count of units.
A photo or short video of the pallets on the certified scale showing the 500kg readout.
A close-up of the underside/joints of a few pallets from the stack in photo 2 to check for rot or damage.
Clarification: is the clean pallet in photos 0-1 representative of all units, or is the lot actually the worn stack in photo 2?
response.reason: The photos show two visually inconsistent conditions (one clean pallet vs a stack of worn pallets) and give no clear count, so neither the quantity nor which condition applies to the actual sale can be fixed even at a worst-case price.
